title: CR-BRK-026 — Admin role edited to remove Admin pages — self-lockout protection
preconds: Edit the Admin system role; attempt to turn OFF App Settings (houses Roles & Permissions) (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Open Admin in the editor; attempt to disable App Settings; save.
expected:
Admin cannot be edited to lose access to the Admin pages (Open Q9: 'Admin system role cannot be edited to lose access to the Admin pages'). The toggle should be prevented/locked.

Risk / Rationale: Admin can remove its own Admin-page access → self-lockout risk.
Spec Ref: Open Q9; Roles list
